verdict.rationale: Plugins and skills can be run from your own infrastructure: you can generate a local marketplace entry, add your own marketplace source via `codex plugin marketplace add`, and keep skills in local `.agents/skills` directories. The plugin source is also published on GitHub. However, plugins still run inside OpenAI's Codex/ChatGPT clients, and nothing in the evidence shows the core plugin platform or runtime can be self-hosted. Missing for 10: self-hostable plugin runtime/platform, documented self-hosting deployment guide, independent corroboration of fully self-hosted operation.
